probe_gate.meaning: PASS = the reads are one fixed length and a panel-sized set of distinct sequences carries most of them, which is what a templated-ligation probe assay looks like and what makes probe-count matching the right quantification. It is NOT a confirmation of any named commercial panel or of its gene content.

probe_map.\u26a0 unassigned_means: no verbatim match to a human cDNA or ncRNA transcript at any core length tried. That is a statement about this matcher, NOT about the probe: a probe spanning a junction the sequence set does not contain, or carrying non-target bases, is unassigned here and is still a real probe.
